messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: autoscaler_provision_latency (PAGER-12345) — severity: high, affected service: inference-queue-prod. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PAGER-12345
PagerDuty: Page details posted, escalation policy: oncall-engineering, current rotation: Mitesh -> Sara -> Eli.
Mitesh: I'm on it, pinging @ops-runner to check node provisioning logs and cloud API errors.
Sara: seeing increased queue depth on kv-inference (tail latency > 3s, backlog ~ 12k reqs). All customer-facing regions seem affected.
Eli: Confirmed: autoscaler metrics show scaling attempts every ~90s but new nodes not becoming Ready. cloud-provision latency spiking 4-6m.
Tom: Any recent deploys? Could be image pull or init scripts blocking.
Mitesh: No deploys in last hour according to deploy-bot. This looks infra-provisioning-related.
ops-runner: Running quick checks: 
```
kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference -o wide
# output: many NotReady or Provisioning states, some nodes stuck in ContainerCreating
```
ops-runner: Cloud API logs show transient 429s from provider when creating instances: RateLimitExceeded.
Sara: 429s would explain slow churn. Are we hitting autoscaler parallelism limit or cloud account rate limits?
Eli: Autoscaler attempted parallel creates but cloud returned throttling. Autoscaler retry backoff increased provisioning time -> cascade.
Mitesh: Immediate mitigation options: 1) increase autoscaler min replicas (manual scale) in control plane to allow warm nodes, 2) switch some low-priority routes to degraded mode, 3) open emergency support with cloud to lift rate limit.
Sara: Let's do 1 + 2 now. I'll bump min_nodes for inference-pool from 10 -> 20 and enable degraded fallback for non-critical customers.
Tom: How do we enable degraded fallback? Is that a config flag?
Eli: Yes, route-policy 'best-effort' will route to smaller model variant and disable KV-prefetch. It's safe for non-SLA customers.
Mitesh: I'm increasing autoscaler min now: 
```
# patch autoscaler
kubectl patch hpa inference-pool -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":20}}'
```
Mitesh: Patch applied. Requesting manual node pool spin-up in cloud console as well (pre-warm to avoid repeated API calls).
ops-runner: Manually requested 10 warm instances (reserved) in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Cloud console shows create requests queued.
Cloud Support Bot: Support ticket created with provider: TICKET-7654. Mentioned rate-limit spike and requested temporary quota bump for instance create QPS.
Sara: Routing change applied: mark 5 customer groups as best-effort; edge traffic shows immediate reduction in queue depth by ~20%. :thumbsup:
Eli: New nodes starting to come up — first 3 Ready in us-west-2, kubelet registration successful. Backlog dropping slowly.
Mitesh: Monitoring - keep an eye on node bootstrap logs for imagePullBackOff or init failures.
ops-runner: Spot instances were used in one zone and some got reclaimed; we've forced reserved instances for the manual pool to avoid spot churn.
Tom: Should we adjust autoscaler parallelism config to reduce cloud API QPS? Maybe slower concurrent creates but less throttling.
Mitesh: Good call. I'll reduce scaleUpConcurrency from 20 -> 8 and increase cooldown to 180s to smooth API requests.
Sara: Noted customer impact: SLO latency breached for less than 15 minutes for ~8% of customers (best-effort unaffected). Logging ticket with CS for outreach.
Eli: PD status update posted: PAGER-12345 acknowledged by Mitesh at +2m. Escalation not needed now.
Mitesh: Actions taken summary: bumped min nodes, manual reserved instances requested, switched low-priority routes to degraded models, reduced autoscaler concurrency. Opened cloud support ticket TICKET-7654.
Tom: Can someone add a follow-up action: add circuit breaker when cloud 429s exceed threshold to automatically switch critical routes to safe-mode?
Sara: I'll create a RFC and attach to the incident later. For now, setting reminder: post-mortem meeting in 2 hours.
ops-runner: All clear? backlog down to ~900 reqs and tail latency trending to normal.
Incident Bot: Incident PAGER-12345 marked as mitigated at 3509876589. Final severity: high -> mitigated.
Eli: I'll stay on hand for handoff to day-shift, collecting logs and timelines.
Mitesh: Thanks team — handing off to Sara for post-incident notes and customer comms. :white_check_mark:
